An externally squash-merged multi-commit pull request whose merge tree equals the accepted head tree and whose merge parent is an ancestor of the accepted head is proven to be a squash.
A multi-commit rebase topology is refused, because the merge parent is a newly created rewrite and is not an ancestor of the accepted head.
An ordinary two-parent merge, a fast-forward, a tree mismatch, a reverted descendant, and an incomplete source inventory each still refuse.
Existing single-source external-squash, provider-action, current-head, and historical-intent recovery paths keep their present behavior.

An externally squash-merged multi-commit pull request carrying GitHub’s default squash body is proven by exact title prefix plus exact authorized token set with no `Attribution:` trailer, while a missing or extra token, and any malformed canonical-looking trailer including an indented one, each refuse.

`--restart-reopened-transaction` authorizes only a single valid transaction whose eight completed steps are exactly the ordered terminal sequence, whose accepted SHA differs from current authority, on an OPEN/REOPENED issue in Review with disposition Delivered and a clean unambiguous binding.

Durable supersession evidence naming both transactions, both accepted SHAs, both delivery authorities, actor, timestamp, and the `completed-close-reopened-corrective-delivery` reason is written and read-back verified BEFORE the active marker is replaced.
The replacement transaction is bound to the current accepted SHA with zero completed steps, and the normal eight-step close saga then converges through Done and issue closure.

Partial, reordered, malformed, duplicate, same-SHA, non-REOPENED, non-Review, non-Delivered, dirty, unbound, and stale-evidence states each refuse before mutation, and without the flag the existing `terminal-state-conflict` refusal is unchanged.

The recovery is idempotent across a lost response, reusing the same replacement identity, and `--restart-stale-transaction`, ordinary close, and generic issue-body marker protection are all unchanged.
